scope: public-contract convergence design only; not implementation qualification or final freeze

implementation_boundaries.decision: Do not rewrite old assignment/review/run. Any post-freeze positive confirmation is a labelled publication projection of real findings, or a newly assigned and explicitly rebound real review; no silent mutation.
Derived reference must preserve old original objects and list complete typed metadata-only differences; existing loader compares complete study/policy, not a semantic subset.
Published INTERFACES and sole JSON paths must exhaust actual required/optional wire and permission scopes, without author-specific or private hidden requirements.

rubric_status_policy: existing draft/frozen only; readiness stays false before final approval
readiness_limit: six-leaf two-format label-masked AI development calibration, not all38 professional/statistical calibration
